title: Pregnancy Tracker - Emily's Journey
content: Week 20 Ultrasound: The fetus is developing well with no complications noted. Growth is on track, and all measurements are within normal ranges. The sex of the baby is femail, which was identified during the scan. Heartbeat is strong, and movements are frequent. Emily is doing great and is scheduled for her next check-up in two weeks.
